title: [solved] Unresponsive after suspend (s2idle) ASUS ProArt PX13
body: My ASUS hybrid laptop doesn't wake from prolonged suspends (hour minimum or something like that). I have to hard reset the laptop to get it to be responsive again. It doesn't seem to leave any logs from crashing. I have tried several different combinations of nvidia settings, I'm not sure they really did a lot. Maybe it's lock utility related (since I don't think I've had this issue when unlocked, or at least the likelihood of it crashing is lower when unlocked, though Id prefer to have it locked). I was using hyprlock, now I am using qylock (quickshell based). I haven't done isolated testing since I am using the laptop actively at university, which makes it difficult to conduct troubleshooting. $ journalctl --since="17:00" | rg -i suspend -C 30 lip 12
